summary: Backend testing for Soul Threading Smart AI IMG2Garment Mapper. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering health, model-status, rules, garment catalog (list + detail + template PNG), upload-artwork (valid + empty rejected), analyze (with/without smart_hint), map end-to-end for a portrait-style and a scene-style synthetic JPEG, jobs status, panel composed/guides PNG retrieval, and ZIP download structure (print/*.png, guides/*.png, mockup/contact_sheet.png, mapping_manifest.json, quality_report.json, mapping_process_log.txt). All 22 tests PASSED against the public URL from frontend/.env (https://garment-ai-map.preview.emergentagent.com). Smart-hint graceful degradation confirmed even with LLM budget exhausted. Note: the review spec referenced a different preview URL (42fc6f0c-...); the actual REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is garment-ai-map.preview.emergentagent.com and both resolve correctly.

minor.issue: Response field `composed_panels` is returned as a LIST of panel keys (e.g. ['master_front','master_back','sleeves','hood','pocket_kangaroo_pocket']) rather than a dict. The review spec said it 'should include ... a pocket_ key' — this is satisfied, but if the frontend or API contract expects a dict/object keyed by panel name, this will break UI. Actual PNG data is served via /api/jobs/{job_id}/panel/{panel_key}?kind=composed|guides which works correctly.

action_items: Confirm whether `composed_panels` should be a dict of panel_key->metadata or the current list-of-keys shape — align with any UI/consumer contract.

The review request referenced preview URL 42fc6f0c-...emergentagent.com but frontend/.env is set to garment-ai-map.preview.emergentagent.com. No action needed unless main agent expected a specific host.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_prune_jobs()` only prunes on POST /api/map — job store can grow unbounded if map is never called; consider prune on GET job endpoints too.
In-memory ARTWORK_STORE and JOB_STORE with no size cap; a busy instance could OOM. Consider LRU eviction or on-disk temp storage.
smart_hint failure is swallowed as {'error': str(e)} silently — good graceful degradation, but no server log warning; add logger.warning for observability.
`@app.on_event('shutdown')` is deprecated in newer FastAPI — consider lifespan handlers.
Content-type sniffing in /api/upload-artwork accepts anything if the header magic bytes match; consider verifying it opens with PIL before storing to reject truncated/corrupt files.
test_credentials: none required — no auth on any endpoint
seed_data_creation: Synthetic portrait & scene JPEGs generated in-test via PIL; no persistent seed data written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is deterministic and self-contained (builds its own JPEGs). Runs in ~26s with pytest-xdist (2 workers). Uses BASE_URL parsed from /app/frontend/.env. Product exercised: oversized_hoodie_design_template (validates pocket underlay path). If backend is hot-reloading during a test run, expect transient 502s — re-run once server is stable (uptime > few sec). LLM smart_hint returns an error field due to exhausted budget — expected.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; only a minor shape observation on composed_panels.
